question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

He looked at me __happily__ when I interrupted him.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Option 1"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct word to be substituted in the above sentence is **"angrily"**. (गुस्से से)
 
• The given sentence is in the **past tense** as the verb **"looked"** is the simple past tense form of the verb **"look."**
 
• **"Angrily"** here implies that the person was upset or irritated when interrupted.
 
• Hence, **"angrily"** is the correct word to be substituted.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

**Correct Sentence**: "He looked at me **angrily**__ when I interrupted him."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Surprisingly"** is incorrect because it suggests that the person looked with astonishment when interrupted. (चकित करते हुए)
 
• **"Suddenly"** is incorrect because it refers to how the action occurs, it doesn't convey the proper meaning. (अचानक)
 
• **"Hardly"** is incorrect because it doesn't make sense in the context of the sentence as It doesn't convey any emotion. (मुश्किल से)
